query: dfki dkt at semeval 2017 task 8 rumour detection and classification using cascading heuristics
sql:

  p.corpus_id,
  p.title,
  p.abstract,
  p.venue,
  p.canonical_venue,
  p.year,
  p.citation_count
FROM Papers p

  to_tsvector('english', coalesce(p.title,'') || ' ' || coalesce(p.abstract,'')) @@
    plainto_tsquery('english', 'dfki & dkt & semeval & rumour & detection & classification')

    plainto_tsquery('english', 'dfki & dkt & semeval & rumour & detection & classification')
  ) DESC
LIMIT 100

query: select answer and explain interpretable multi hop reading comprehension over multiple documents
sql:
SELECT
  p.corpus_id,
  p.title,
  p.abstract,
  p.canonical_venue,
  p.venue,
  p.year,
  p.citation_count
FROM Papers p
WHERE
  (
    to_tsvector('english', coalesce(p.title, '') || ' ' || coalesce(p.abstract, '')) @@
      plainto_tsquery('english',
        'multi-hop | multihop & (reading & comprehension | question & answering | QA) & (explainable | interpretable | explanation | rationale)')
  )
  OR (
    lower(p.title) LIKE '%multi hop%'
    OR lower(p.title) LIKE '%multi-hop%'
    OR lower(p.title) LIKE '%multihop%'
  )
  OR (
    lower(p.abstract) LIKE '%multi hop%'
    OR lower(p.abstract) LIKE '%multi-hop%'
    OR lower(p.abstract) LIKE '%multihop%'
  )
  OR (
    lower(p.title) LIKE '%reading comprehension%'
    OR lower(p.abstract) LIKE '%reading comprehension%'
  )
  OR (
    lower(p.title) LIKE '%question answering%'
    OR lower(p.abstract) LIKE '%question answering%'
  )
  OR (
    lower(p.title) LIKE '%explainable%'
    OR lower(p.abstract) LIKE '%explainable%'
    OR lower(p.title) LIKE '%interpretable%'
    OR lower(p.abstract) LIKE '%interpretable%'
    OR lower(p.title) LIKE '%explanation%'
    OR lower(p.abstract) LIKE '%explanation%'
    OR lower(p.title) LIKE '%rationale%'
    OR lower(p.abstract) LIKE '%rationale%'
  )
ORDER BY
  p.citation_count DESC NULLS LAST,
  p.year DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 100

query: challenges in automating maze detection
sql:
SELECT
  p.corpus_id,
  p.title,
  p.abstract,
  p.year,
  p.citation_count
FROM Papers p
WHERE
  (p.title ILIKE '%maze%' OR p.abstract ILIKE '%maze%')
  AND (p.title ILIKE '%detect%' OR p.abstract ILIKE '%detect%')
  AND (p.title ILIKE '%automat%' OR p.abstract ILIKE '%automat%')
ORDER BY
  (CASE WHEN p.title ILIKE '%maze%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
   CASE WHEN p.abstract ILIKE '%maze%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
   CASE WHEN p.title ILIKE '%detect%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
   CASE WHEN p.abstract ILIKE '%detect%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
   CASE WHEN p.title ILIKE '%automat%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
   CASE WHEN p.abstract ILIKE '%automat%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) DESC,
  p.citation_count DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 100

query: amr parsing with an incremental joint model
sql:
SELECT
  p.corpus_id,
  p.title,
  p.abstract,
  p.canonical_venue,
  p.year,
  p.citation_count
FROM Papers p
WHERE
  (p.title ILIKE '%amr%' OR p.abstract ILIKE '%amr%')
  AND (p.title ILIKE '%parsing%' OR p.abstract ILIKE '%parsing%')
  AND (
    p.title ILIKE '%incremental%' OR p.abstract ILIKE '%incremental%'
    OR p.title ILIKE '%joint model%' OR p.abstract ILIKE '%joint model%'
    OR p.title ILIKE '%joint%' OR p.abstract ILIKE '%joint%'
  )
ORDER BY
  ((CASE WHEN p.title ILIKE '%amr%' THEN 2 ELSE 0 END) +
   (CASE WHEN p.abstract ILIKE '%amr%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) +
   (CASE WHEN p.title ILIKE '%parsing%' THEN 2 ELSE 0 END) +
   (CASE WHEN p.abstract ILIKE '%parsing%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) +
   (CASE WHEN p.title ILIKE '%incremental%' THEN 2 ELSE 0 END) +
   (CASE WHEN p.abstract ILIKE '%incremental%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) +
   (CASE WHEN p.title ILIKE '%joint model%' THEN 2 ELSE 0 END) +
   (CASE WHEN p.abstract ILIKE '%joint model%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) +
   (CASE WHEN p.title ILIKE '%joint%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) +
   (CASE WHEN p.abstract ILIKE '%joint%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
  ) DESC,
  p.citation_count DESC
LIMIT 100

     ELSE 1
   END) DESC,
  p.citation_count DESC
LIMIT 100

query: online hashing with efficient updating of binary codes
sql:
SELECT
  p.corpus_id,
  p.title,
  p.abstract,
  p.citation_count,
  p.year
FROM Papers p
WHERE
  (p.title ILIKE '%online hashing%' OR

  OR (
    (p.title ILIKE '%hashing%' OR p.abstract ILIKE '%hashing%')
    AND (p.title ILIKE '%online%' OR p.abstract ILIKE '%online%')
  )
  OR (
    (p.title ILIKE '%binary code%' OR p.abstract ILIKE '%binary code%')
    OR (p.title ILIKE '%binary codes%' OR p.abstract ILIKE '%binary codes%')
  )
ORDER BY
  (CASE
     WHEN p.title ILIKE '%online hashing with efficient updating of binary codes%' THEN 5
     WHEN p.title ILIKE '%online hashing%' AND p.title ILIKE '%binary code%' THEN 4
     WHEN p.title ILIKE '%online hashing%' AND p.title ILIKE '%binary codes%' THEN 4
     WHEN p.title ILIKE '%online hashing%' THEN 3
     WHEN (p.title ILIKE '%hashing%' OR p.abstract ILIKE '%hashing%')
          AND (p.title ILIKE '%online%' OR p.abstract ILIKE '%online%') THEN 2
     WHEN p.title ILIKE '%binary code%' OR p.title ILIKE '%binary codes%' THEN 1
     ELSE 0
   END) DESC,
  p.citation_count DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 100

query: finding word substitutions using a distributional similarity baseline and immediate context overlap
sql:
SELECT
  p.corpus_id,
  p.title,
  p.abstract,
  p.canonical_venue,
  p.year,
  p.citation_count
FROM Papers p
WHERE
  (
    p.title ILIKE '%word substitution%' OR
    p.title ILIKE '%lexical substitution%' OR
    p.title ILIKE '%lexical substitution task%' OR
    p.title ILIKE '%substitution%' OR
    p.title ILIKE '%paraphrase%' OR
    p.title ILIKE '%lexical choice%' OR
    p.title ILIKE '%lexical simplification%' OR
    p.title ILIKE '%contextual similarity%' OR
    p.title ILIKE '%distributional similarity%' OR
    p.title ILIKE '%context overlap%'
  )
  OR (
    p.abstract IS NOT NULL AND (
      p.abstract ILIKE '%word substitution%' OR
      p.abstract ILIKE '%lexical substitution%' OR
      p.abstract ILIKE '%lexical substitution task%' OR
      p.abstract ILIKE '%substitution candidate%' OR
      p.abstract ILIKE '%candidate substitution%' OR
      p.abstract ILIKE '%lexical choice%' OR
      p.abstract ILIKE '%lexical simplification%' OR
      p.abstract ILIKE '%distributional similarity%' OR
      p.abstract ILIKE '%distributional thesaurus%' OR
      p.abstract ILIKE '%context overlap%' OR
      p.abstract ILIKE '%contextual overlap%' OR
      p.abstract ILIKE '%immediate context%' OR
      p.abstract ILIKE '%local context%' OR
      p.abstract ILIKE '%context window%' OR
      (p.abstract ILIKE '%substitution%' AND p.abstract ILIKE '%context%')
    )
  )
ORDER BY
  p.citation_count DESC NULLS LAST,
  p.year DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 100

sql:
SELECT
  p.corpus_id,
  p.title,
  p.abstract,
  p.canonical_venue,
  p.year,

  (p.title ILIKE '%idiom%' OR p.abstract ILIKE '%idiom%')

  (p.title ILIKE '%italian%' OR p.abstract ILIKE '%italian%')

   CASE WHEN p.abstract ILIKE '%italian idiom%' THEN 3 ELSE 0 END +
   CASE WHEN p.title ILIKE '%lexicon%' OR p.title ILIKE '%lexical%' THEN 2 ELSE 0 END +
   CASE WHEN p.title ILIKE '%grammar%' THEN 2 ELSE 0 END +
   CASE WHEN p.abstract ILIKE '%lexicon%' OR p.abstract ILIKE '%lexical%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
   CASE WHEN p.abstract ILIKE '%grammar%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) DESC,
  p.citation_count DESC
LIMIT 100

     WHEN p.title ILIKE '%mixture%' THEN 1 ELSE 0

     WHEN p.abstract ILIKE '%mixture%' THEN 1 ELSE 0

     WHEN p.title ILIKE '%latent domain%' OR p.title ILIKE '%latent domains%' THEN 1 ELSE 0
   END +
   CASE
     WHEN p.abstract ILIKE '%latent domain%' OR p.abstract ILIKE '%latent domains%' THEN 1 ELSE 0

sql:
SELECT
  p.corpus_id,
  p.title,
  p.abstract,
  p.canonical_venue,
  p.venue,
  p.year,
  p.citation_count

    OR
    (p.abstract ILIKE '%referential translation machine%' OR p.abstract ILIKE '%referential translation machines%')
  )
  OR (
    (p.title ILIKE '%translation quality%' OR p.abstract ILIKE '%translation quality%')
    AND (p.title ILIKE '%prediction%' OR p.abstract ILIKE '%prediction%' OR p.title ILIKE '%predicting%' OR p.abstract ILIKE '%predicting%')
  )
ORDER BY
  CASE
    WHEN p.title ILIKE '%referential translation machine%' THEN 4
    WHEN p.title ILIKE '%referential translation machines%' THEN 4
    WHEN p.abstract ILIKE '%referential translation machine%' THEN 3
    WHEN p.abstract ILIKE '%referential translation machines%' THEN 3
    WHEN (p.title ILIKE '%translation quality%' OR p.abstract ILIKE '%translation quality%')
         AND (p.title ILIKE '%prediction%' OR p.abstract ILIKE '%prediction%' OR p.title ILIKE '%predicting%' OR p.abstract ILIKE '%predicting%')
      THEN 2
    ELSE 1
  END DESC,
  p.citation_count DESC NULLS LAST,
  p.year DESC NULLS LAST

query: eacl expansion of abbreviations in clinical text
sql:
SELECT
  p.corpus_id,
  p.title,
  p.abstract,
  p.canonical_venue,
  p.venue,
  p.year,
  p.citation_count
FROM Papers p
WHERE
  p.canonical_venue ILIKE 'EACL'
  AND (
    (p.title ILIKE '%expansion%' OR p.abstract ILIKE '%expansion%')
    AND (p.title ILIKE '%abbreviation%' OR p.abstract ILIKE '%abbreviation%' OR
         p.title ILIKE '%acronym%' OR p.abstract ILIKE '%acronym%')
    AND (p.title ILIKE '%clinical%' OR p.abstract ILIKE '%clinical%' OR
         p.title ILIKE '%medical%' OR p.abstract ILIKE '%medical%')
  )
ORDER BY
  (CASE WHEN p.title ILIKE '%expansion of abbreviations in clinical text%' THEN 3 ELSE 0 END +
        CASE WHEN p.title ILIKE '%expansion%' THEN 2 ELSE 0 END +
        CASE WHEN p.title ILIKE '%abbreviation%' OR p.title ILIKE '%acronym%' THEN 2 ELSE 0 END +
        CASE WHEN p.title ILIKE '%clinical%' OR p.title ILIKE '%medical%' THEN 2 ELSE 0 END +
        CASE WHEN p.abstract ILIKE '%expansion%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
        CASE WHEN p.abstract ILIKE '%abbreviation%' OR p.abstract ILIKE '%acronym%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
        CASE WHEN p.abstract ILIKE '%clinical%' OR p.abstract ILIKE '%medical%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
  ) DESC,
  p.citation_count DESC,
  p.year DESC
LIMIT 100

query: enjambment detection in a large diachronic corpus of spanish sonnets
sql:
SELECT
  p.corpus_id,
  p.title,
  p.abstract,
  p.canonical_venue,
  p.year,
  p.citation_count,
  ts_rank_cd(
    setweight(to_tsvector('english', coalesce(p.title, '')), 'A') ||
    setweight(to_tsvector('english', coalesce(p.abstract, '')), 'B'),
    plainto_tsquery('english', 'enjambment') ||
    plainto_tsquery('english', 'spanish') ||
    plainto_tsquery('english', 'sonnet') ||
    plainto_tsquery('english', 'poetry') ||
    plainto_tsquery('english', 'corpus')
  ) AS relevance
FROM Papers p
WHERE
  (
    to_tsvector('english', coalesce(p.title, '') || ' ' || coalesce(p.abstract, ''))
    @@ (
      plainto_tsquery('english', 'enjambment') &&
      (plainto_tsquery('english', 'spanish') || plainto_tsquery('english', 'spanish sonnets') || plainto_tsquery('english', 'spanish poetry'))
    )
  )
  OR (
    lower(p.title) LIKE '%enjambment%' OR lower(p.abstract) LIKE '%enjambment%'
  )
ORDER BY relevance DESC, p.citation_count DESC NULLS LAST, p.year DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 100
